We helped secure $6 million in authorized funding for water and wastewater infrastructure in the City of Beaufort. This is part of the $100 million in Lowcountry authorizations we fought to include in the Water Resources Development Act, which passed committee. 

Reliable water and wastewater infrastructure is essential to protecting public health, supporting responsible growth, and strengthening Beaufort's economy.

The Water Resources Development Act  now heads to the House for consideration.
